podcast.body: A classic 1976 hit by Christine McVie. During Fleetwood Mac's 1998 induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, this song was chosen to open their acoustic set, rather than any of the bigger hits from the "Rumours" album. "they performed an acoustic set that was led off, not by any of the big rumors hits, but rather Christine's classic 1976 hit Say You Love Me."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
